name: Internet & cloud outages
value: No major outage in 48h to 25 Nov
summary: No major cloud, CDN or payments outage over 2h found in the 48h to 25 Nov; the mid-November wave of outages has passed
state: A run of US outages from 12 to 17 Nov included a near-24-hour Microsoft Outlook and Teams failure, a four-hour FAA nationwide ground stop on 13 Nov, a Chase software bug on 16 Nov and an Apple services outage on 17 Nov (Fortune). Searches for 23 to 25 Nov found no cloud, CDN or payments outage lasting more than two hours. With none in the past 48h, Normal holds.
for_you: No widespread outage is affecting services. Providers' own status pages give the quickest confirmation if a service stops working.
rubric_hit: Normal: no major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage in the past 48h

sources.title: Fortune — Outlook, FAA and Chase outages

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
